x: Lindner of East Germany ( a very bouncy performer indeed - he was disqualified at Melbourne for "lifting") and Max Weber also of the home country came up to my shoulder and a battle of tactics as to who should lead into the wind developed.
Singh scampered thro' the first lap in 94.3 secs. revelling in his moment of glory with Matthews, Vickers, Colin Williams, Adjit Singh and Lindner hard on his heels.

Secondly, when battling with Lindner, and just a lap to go, I heard my number called. I broke my rhythm slightly but couldn't see a judge (in those days it was instant dismissal) and so got going again finishing, as you say, fourth.
